headline: Shell Reports Near-Record Profit as Refining Margins Hit $42 a Barrel
summary: Shell reported its second-highest profit ever as oil refining margins surged to a record $42 a barrel, up from $24.
why: Integrated oil majors' downstream refining margins and earnings reports serve as broad proxies for global energy sector cash flow generation and commodity demand.

impacts.name: Shell PLC
impacts.why: Record refining margins drive substantial corporate earnings and cash flow expansion.
